selection: Current weather-category series matching the declared temperature metadata pattern; deterministic series and contract ticker order only. Initial and each ten-minute bucket refresh. Keep every observed excluded/capped/missing case. Unknown contract rules or station mappings remain unsupported, never inferred.
receipt_policy: Every response is archived with actual request and local receipt timestamps. Each full canonical report/point/calibration revision has a unique first-successful-local-receipt record per registration, linked from every subsequent observation. Provider receiptTime/received_at_ms, observation time and reportTime remain distinct. Initial reports and pre-registration observations are backfill, not contemporaneously observed news.
budget_policy: Persist request/byte reservations before HTTP I/O. Charge all returned payload bytes, including failures. Interrupted requests conservatively retain their entire reservation, with16KiB overflow detection allowance. Headers/TLS bytes excluded. Fixed24h deadline never extends on resume; interrupted/missed slots are retained and not replayed.
scope: Prospective data acquisition only. No signals, scores, model updates, fills or orders. METAR is not a settlement label. MIA component administrator receipt is not this collector's first receipt. Sixty-second polling cannot establish subminute reactions or executable liquidity. No account credentials or paid APIs. Old E017/E018 windows remain frozen.
